elements.text: LayoutLMv3: Pre-training for Document AI with Visual & Spatial Tokens
Abstract: Multi-modal document understanding requires joint modeling of textual content, 2D spatial layouts, and visual features within a unified transformer architecture.
Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax((Q K^T) / sqrt(d_k)) V

formula.text: Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax( (Q K^T) / sqrt(d_k) ) V

elements.text: Column 1: To capture relative positional bias across 2D visual layouts, we incorporate two-dimensional spatial coordinate embeddings derived from bounding box tuples.
Column 2: Visual patch tokens are extracted directly via linear projection of non-overlapping image patches, bypassing expensive faster R-CNN visual backbones.
